items.title: Bill Dobbins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: Cedar Walton’s Eastern Rebellion Band and he had Bob Berg working in the band

ctx.x: Well actually I tell a lot about things that I’ve gone through in my life. I mean this thing with the trip to Switzerland that the band made, and some of the things that I’ve gone

through with Clark Terry, and actually another connection with Clark too is when I got the job as music director for the WDR Big Band in Cologne, I arranged with a producer there at the first concert that I did with the band as the new director that Clark Terry would be a guest soloist. And so that was great too. And since I came back from Germany too, fortunately we were able to have Clark here a couple of times. He’d been here a couple of times before we left for Germany, and I made sure that he was here…
You know I think historians and sociologists and so forth who write about the music, they want it to be an issue more than it is. Because it’s better copy.
